elements.evidence: The rendered clause retains a non-solicitation covenant binding both parties: "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who is or was directly involved in such services to leave his or her employment". Customer (Licensee) therefore remains subject to a restriction, so the preferred position is not achieved.

Rendered text substitutes the one-sided "the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates" with "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party", which binds Licensor and Licensee symmetrically.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Coverage is confined to "any person employed by the other party who is or was directly involved in such services", i.e. "the services provided under this Agreement"; the prior all-personnel reach ("any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates", including Affiliate staff) is removed.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: Duration reads "During the twelve (12) month period after the end of that person's involvement in the services provided under this Agreement"; the "Term of this Agreement" limb and the three-year post-termination tail are deleted, so no standing period can extend the covenant. The deterministic duration check reported "number not found", but that is a regex artifact — the operative words spell the cap as "twelve (12) month" measured from the end of involvement, which satisfies the element in substance.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The definitional sentence is retained verbatim: "Solicit" "shall not mean generally advertising job openings or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements".

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Retained carve-out covers individuals "who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries", excluding unsolicited approaches from the prohibition.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition is limited to soliciting a person "to leave his or her employment with that party"; there is no "employ or engage", "hire" or no-hire language anywhere in the rendered paragraph.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete on the operative language: mutual scope, personnel directly involved in the services, a single 12-month post-involvement cap, retained advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-outs, and no hiring prohibition.
Preferred level is not reached because a mutual non-solicit continues to bind Customer; that is acceptable since the redline lands squarely at the accepted fallback.

Minimality holds: only the first sentence (duration, party direction, personnel scope) was rewritten — precisely the terms that failed the fallback — and the definitional carve-out sentence is preserved word for word. Deleting the "Term of this Agreement" limb is necessary, not cosmetic, because leaving it would allow the covenant to run for the whole Term irrespective of the 12-month post-involvement cap.
No extras were added: no survival tail, no remedies, no damages or procedural mechanics beyond the checklist.

Intent is preserved: the defined term "Solicit" remains anchored to the retained definition sentence, no cross-reference is left dangling, the Affiliate definition is simply no longer invoked (not orphaned elsewhere by this edit), and no retained sentence contradicts the new mutual formulation.
